shots.description: Aerial drone shot travelling forward above a street of period terraced buildings in central London, likely the Marylebone/Harley Street area, with cars parked along both sides of the road. No hospital signage is visible.

Aerial drone shot moving over the rooftops and terraced buildings of central London's Marylebone area, following a long straight street toward the trees of Regent's Park on the horizon. The shot works as an establishing view of the Harley Street medical district.

Aerial drone shot moving forward over a long straight street lined with terraced and mansion block buildings in central London, with a large park and trees on the horizon. Establishing view of the Marylebone and Harley Street area; no hospital signage is visible.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over the terraced streets and rooftops of Marylebone, London, around the Harley Street area, with a large park and the city skyline in the background. A long straight street runs through the centre of the frame.

Aerial drone shot moving forward over a central London street lined with terraced and white modern buildings, with a large tree-filled park and the city skyline beyond. Traffic is parked and moving along the road below.

Aerial drone shot over central London rooftops and white stucco terraces beside a tree-lined park, tilting down to a quiet street with a few cars and a tree in blossom. No hospital building or signage is identifiable.

Aerial drone shot tracking along a central London street lined with red-brick period buildings, with a dark car driving past parked cars below. Establishing view of the Harley Street area, with no hospital signage visible.

Aerial drone shot looking down on a Marylebone street of red-brick Georgian and Victorian terraces near Harley Street, with parked cars along the kerbs. The camera drifts slowly over the rooftops and the quiet road.

Aerial drone shot tracking along a row of Georgian terraced townhouses, including a red-brick building with bay windows, on a central London street in the Harley Street area, with cars parked along the kerb and rooftops in the foreground.

Aerial drone shot moving along a London street of Georgian brick terraced townhouses with cars parked along both kerbs, ending at a road junction. It works as an establishing shot of the Harley Street medical district; no clinic signage is visible.

Aerial drone shot moving over rooftops and chimneys toward a terrace of brick and stone townhouses on a London street in the Harley Street area, then rising to show the street from above with parked cars and vans.

Aerial drone shot tracking along a London street of white stucco and brick terraced townhouses, with cars parked along the kerb and scaffolded rooftops in the foreground. This is a neighbourhood establishing shot for the Harley Street area; no clinic signage is visible.
Aerial drone shot tracking along a London street of white stucco terraced buildings and red-brick houses, with cars and a yellow van parked along the kerb and a few vehicles driving past.
Aerial drone shot moving over the terraced streets of London's Harley Street area, passing period buildings and parked cars before crossing a street junction with light traffic.

Aerial drone shot looking down on a Marylebone street junction lined with red-brick and stone mansion blocks and parked cars, moving slowly over the rooftops near Harley Street. Ungraded, low-contrast footage.
Aerial drone shot moving over red-brick mansion blocks and a street junction in the Harley Street area of central London, with cars parked along the roads. No clinic signage is visible.

Aerial drone shot moving over the rooftops and street grid of a central London neighbourhood of red-brick and stone mansion blocks on an overcast day, with traffic passing through a junction below. No hospital building or signage is identifiable in the shot.

Aerial drone shot moving forward over central London rooftops and terraced mansion blocks, consistent with the Harley Street area of Marylebone, tilting down toward a street junction with parked cars. No hospital signage is visible.
A nurse in burgundy scrubs walks away from camera down a hospital corridor at The Harley Street Clinic, carrying paperwork and passing framed artwork and patient room doors.
A nurse in a maroon tunic walks away from camera down an arched, period-style corridor with framed artwork, then pushes open a wooden door into a clinical room at The Harley Street Clinic.

Dimly lit hospital interior with a keypad-locked door, a wall-mounted control panel with red and orange buttons, a privacy curtain and a clinical area with a yellow-lidded sharps bin. The camera moves across the space and the middle of the shot is motion-blurred.
A nurse in a burgundy tunic walks away from camera down a hospital corridor, then turns to look back over her shoulder while holding paperwork.

A staff member in a burgundy tunic walks away from camera down a long arched corridor with a patterned tiled floor and wooden doors, pointing ahead as she goes. The camera follows behind her towards a door with warning signage.

A mammography room with the machine, a stool and a window, as a folding privacy screen is pulled closed across the view. A staff member's hand is seen drawing the screen, with glove dispensers on the wall behind.

Follow shot from behind of a woman with a shoulder bag walking down a corridor at The Harley Street Clinic, led through a doorway by a staff member in a maroon uniform. The image is heavily overexposed in the first half of the shot.
A woman in a pink shirt carrying a handbag and paperwork is followed from behind into a mammography room with a privacy screen, where a staff member in a burgundy top is waiting.
Two female staff members, one in a burgundy uniform holding papers and one in a pink shirt, walk towards camera along an arched, period-style hospital corridor with wooden doors and framed artwork.
A staff member in a maroon uniform follows a colleague in a pink shirt through a doorway into a small room with a tall white cabinet, then hands her a sheet of paper as they talk.

A staff member in a maroon tunic, holding paperwork, shows a woman in a pink shirt into a changing cubicle and draws a grey curtain across for privacy. Both are seen mostly from behind in a clinical corridor area with cubicle doors.

A nurse in burgundy scrubs holding a sheet of paper walks a smiling woman in a pink blouse with a handbag along a hospital corridor at The Harley Street Clinic, chatting as they go. The camera moves backwards ahead of them and comes around as the nurse glances back.

Two staff members, one in a pink shirt carrying a shoulder bag and one in a maroon uniform, walk down a hospital corridor at The Harley Street Clinic. The woman in pink opens a white door and turns back to smile at her colleague.

A radiographer in a burgundy tunic stands at a Hologic mammography unit and adjusts the machine in an imaging room. The camera moves around the machine, ending on a close view of the compression paddle and detector.
A nurse in a burgundy uniform talks and looks down while working at a neonatal incubator on a neonatal unit, filmed through the incubator's clear canopy and equipment.

A radiographer in maroon scrubs prepares a mammography machine in a breast imaging room, adjusting the unit as the camera moves past the clear compression paddle to a side view of her and the machine.
A radiographer in maroon scrubs adjusts the face shield on a Hologic 3Dimensions mammography unit, then steps back and looks over the machine in the breast imaging room.

A radiographer in a maroon tunic stands beside a Hologic 3Dimensions mammography machine in a breast imaging room as the camera moves around the equipment. A second mammography unit is visible in the background.
A radiographer in a maroon uniform looks at the camera, then turns to adjust the clear face shield on a mammography machine in a breast imaging room.
A radiographer in a burgundy tunic stands beside a mammography machine and explains the procedure to a woman seen from behind in the foreground, in a breast imaging room at The Harley Street Clinic.
A radiographer in a maroon uniform adjusts a Hologic mammography machine and then turns to talk to a patient, who is seen from behind and out of focus in the foreground, in a breast imaging room.

A woman in a pink shirt stands with her hands clasped in a mammography room with leaded stained-glass windows, talking with a staff member in burgundy scrubs seen from behind. The camera moves sideways to reveal the mammography unit beside her.

A woman in a pink shirt stands with her hands clasped beside a 3Dimensions mammography unit, listening to a colleague in a magenta top who is seen from behind in the foreground. The camera moves slowly around them in a bright mammography room with leaded-glass windows.
Close-up of a Hologic 3Dimensions mammography unit's tube head in an imaging room, its display showing exposure settings, with daylight coming through a window behind.
Close-up of the control panel buttons on a Hologic Selenia Dimensions mammography unit, with the machine's head and compression paddle out of focus in the background. No people are in shot.

A Hologic mammography unit in an empty imaging room at The Harley Street Clinic, with a period fireplace with a copper hood on the wall behind. The camera moves past the machine to reveal the fireplace and the room.

A camera move across a mammography room at The Harley Street Clinic, past a period wooden fireplace, revealing a Hologic 3Dimensions mammography unit beside leaded glass windows. No people are in the room.

Camera moves slowly along a row of leaded glass windows with geometric patterns, white painted frames and brass fittings, with soft daylight coming through the textured glass. An interior period architecture detail at The Harley Street Clinic.

Low-angle view of leaded and frosted glass windows with geometric patterns and white painted frames, with daylight coming through. The camera moves sideways along the window bays, showing the period architectural detail of The Harley Street Clinic.

A cardiologist in a sterile gown and lead thyroid collar prepares a syringe beside a draped patient in a cardiac catheterisation lab, with live X-ray angiography and haemodynamic monitors behind him. A colleague in a lead apron works at the table in the background.

Two clinicians in sterile gowns, lead thyroid collars and surgical caps stand at the procedure table in a cath lab, working on a draped patient. Behind them are the C-arm X-ray system, monitors and IV drip bags.
A gowned and gloved clinician prepares and flushes a catheter over a sterile draped trolley in a cardiac catheterisation lab, while a colleague in a lead apron works in the background.

Two clinicians in sterile gowns, caps and masks stand at a draped table in a cardiac catheter lab with their backs to camera, working on a procedure while facing a large monitor showing a live X-ray image and vital signs.

A clinician in a sterile gown, mask and scrub cap moves in the foreground of a cardiac catheterisation lab while a colleague in a lead apron and scrub cap stands behind, with the control room window and monitors in the background.
Close-up of a clinician in a lead apron operating the table-side control panel during a procedure in the cath lab, with a draped patient on the table and monitors in the background.

In a cath lab, a team member's hand operates the illuminated table-side control panel beside a draped patient table. The camera pulls back to show two clinicians in scrubs at the table and a colleague in a lead apron watching from the back of the room.

A clinician in a lead apron and scrub cap stands at the table-side controls in a cath lab while gowned colleagues work over a draped patient table, with the camera moving in to a side profile of her face. Other theatre staff in lead aprons and masks are seen in the background.

Two gowned and masked clinicians work at a draped patient table in a cath lab during a procedure while colleagues in red tabards look on, with fluoroscopy monitors and a hanging lead shield in view. The camera moves right past a staff member in the foreground toward the operating team.
Two consultants in sterile gowns, caps and masks carry out a procedure at a draped patient table in a cath lab, while two staff members in lead aprons watch from the back of the room.
Two clinicians in sterile gowns perform a procedure at a draped patient table in a cath lab while two staff in red lead aprons watch from behind, with IV bags and imaging monitors around them.
Two clinicians in sterile gowns, caps and masks perform a procedure at a draped patient table in a cath lab at The Harley Street Clinic, with a Siemens C-arm and IV drip stand in the foreground.

A clinician in a scrub cap and red lead apron watches screens during a procedure in a cath lab, with a C-arm in the foreground. A masked colleague in a lead apron stands behind him, and another team member moves in the background beside shelves of supplies.
Close-up profile of a woman in a blue disposable hair cap and glasses looking off to the left in a theatre area. Supply cabinets and staff in scrubs are blurred in the background.

Close-up of a staff member's hands operating the illuminated tableside control panel beside a patient covered in a blue sterile drape during a procedure in the cath lab. The staff member wears a red lead apron printed with 'HSC Cath Lab'.
A male clinician in blue scrubs and a theatre cap holds a sheet of paper and talks two female colleagues through a pre-procedure briefing in an operating theatre. One colleague wears a lead apron.

Three theatre staff in scrubs and surgical caps hold a team briefing in an operating theatre. The man in the centre talks, gestures and holds a sheet of paper while two female colleagues, one wearing a lead apron, listen.

Three clinical staff in scrubs and theatre caps hold a team briefing in an operating theatre. A man holding a sheet of paper talks while two female colleagues listen, one wearing a lead apron and thyroid collar.
A masked surgical team in scrubs and caps works over a draped patient in an operating theatre, filmed through out-of-focus equipment and drip stands in the foreground as the camera moves sideways.

A clinician in blue scrubs, a scrub cap and a surgical mask watches over a procedure in an operating theatre, with a patient monitor showing vital signs behind her. The shot is framed past an out-of-focus pillar in the foreground.

A surgeon in green scrubs, a surgical cap, a mask and magnifying loupes works looking down at the operating table during a procedure, with a monitor behind him and a blurred colleague in the foreground. Near the end of the shot he looks up towards the camera.
Surgical team in gowns, masks and caps work over a draped patient in an operating theatre. Gloved hands handle a syringe and instruments over the sterile field as the camera moves across the team.
Two gowned theatre staff in surgical caps, masks and safety glasses work at a draped operating table during a procedure, with the camera moving between them.
A surgical team in gowns, masks and caps operates on a draped patient in an operating theatre, with a surgeon wearing loupes and a headlight working alongside a colleague at the operating table.
Close-up in an operating theatre of a surgeon's gloved hands on a patient's prepped, draped back, one hand steadying the skin while the other works an instrument at a small incision.

Close-up in an operating theatre that moves from gloved hands working at an open surgical site with instruments and suction tubing to the profile of a surgeon wearing a mask, scrub cap and magnifying loupes as he concentrates on the procedure.
Close-up of surgeons' gloved hands performing open surgery on a draped patient's torso in an operating theatre, using a diathermy pen and gauze at the incision.

A surgeon in scrubs, cap, mask and tinted protective glasses looks down while operating in a theatre, with a patient monitor out of focus behind him. A colleague passes through the foreground at the end of the shot.

Close-up of a surgeon wearing a surgical cap, mask and loupes, looking down as he operates, with a second surgeon out of focus in the foreground. Filmed in an operating theatre at The Harley Street Clinic.
Close-up of a surgeon in a scrub cap, surgical mask and tinted protective glasses looking down as he operates in an operating theatre, with a screen and another blurred team member in the background.
Close-up profile of a surgeon in a scrub cap, surgical mask and magnifying loupes, looking down in concentration during an operation in an operating theatre.

A clinician in a surgical cap, mask and scrubs watches the procedure from behind green surgical drapes in a theatre at The Harley Street Clinic, with an ultrasound monitor and IV drip bags behind her. She glances toward the camera before looking back across the room.
A clinician in a surgical cap and mask works at the head of the operating table behind a green surgical drape, looking down, with patient monitors showing vital signs behind her.
A surgeon in theatre scrubs, surgical cap, mask and magnifying loupes operates at the table, holding a surgical instrument. The camera tilts down from his face to his gloved hands as he works.

A surgeon wearing surgical loupes, a scrub cap and a mask looks down and concentrates during an operation in an operating theatre, with green sterile drapes beside him. A colleague passes out of focus in the foreground at the start of the shot.
In an operating theatre, a surgeon in scrubs and a cap stands out of focus in the foreground while an Aesculap monitor shows a live laparoscopic view inside the abdomen during keyhole surgery.

A surgical team in gowns, caps, masks and loupes operates on a draped patient in an operating theatre, filmed through foreground drip stands and equipment. The surgeons work over an open surgical site, which appears to be cardiac surgery.

A surgical team in scrubs, masks and loupes operates on a draped patient in an operating theatre, filmed from behind drip stands in the foreground. The procedure appears to be open-chest cardiac surgery.
A clinician in a surgical cap, glasses, mask and gown looks down while working during a procedure in an operating theatre, with gowned theatre team members behind her.

Two theatre staff in scrubs, surgical caps, masks and protective eyewear work during a procedure while a surgeon looks down at the operating field. The focus shifts from the foreground team member to the surgeon, with a video monitor showing a pink internal image in the background.

Close-up of a surgeon wearing surgical loupes, a lilac face mask and a scrub cap, looking down as he operates in an operating theatre, with green surgical drapes and another theatre team member out of focus behind him.

Close-up side profile of a surgeon wearing a scrub cap, surgical mask and magnifying loupes, looking down as he concentrates during an operation in theatre. Theatre staff and green drapes are blurred in the background.

Two surgeons in gowns, caps and masks, one wearing surgical loupes, lean over and operate in an operating theatre. The camera moves right across gowned team members to gloved hands working over a lit sterile field.

A surgical team in scrubs, caps, masks and glasses works over a patient at the operating table in an operating theatre. The camera moves sideways past a foreground pole to show three team members concentrating on the procedure.

A surgical team in gowns, masks and caps operates on a draped patient in an operating theatre, with the camera moving past foreground equipment. Several surgeons stand at the table while another team member watches from behind the drapes.
Close-up of the roller pump heads on a Stöckert S5 heart-lung bypass machine, with clear covers and tubing lines, as the camera tracks slowly across the console. Used in cardiac surgery perfusion.

A surgeon in a mask, scrub cap and 3D glasses performs keyhole surgery in an operating theatre, with a monitor behind him showing the internal camera view. Theatre staff in scrubs are out of focus in the foreground and draped instruments stand beside the patient.

In an operating theatre, a laparoscopic camera feed shows internal tissue and blood vessels on a screen during keyhole surgery, next to a patient monitor displaying vital signs. Theatre staff in scrub caps and masks are in the foreground as the camera moves across the scene.

Surgical team in scrubs and caps, seen from behind in an operating theatre, watch a screen showing a live laparoscopic (keyhole) procedure with instruments inside the abdomen. A patient monitor showing vital signs sits beside the screen under the theatre lights.
A surgeon in glasses, a blue scrub cap and a purple face mask looks down as she operates in an operating theatre, with other members of the theatre team working out of focus behind her.

Surgeons in scrubs, caps and masks perform keyhole (laparoscopic) surgery in an operating theatre, using handheld instruments through ports in a draped patient's abdomen while the camera view shows on a screen behind.

Close-up of a clinician in a blue scrub cap and surgical mask working beside stacked infusion pumps and monitors in an operating theatre, looking up at the equipment and then down towards the patient area.

Two men in dark suits stand side by side on prayer mats in a small prayer room at The Harley Street Clinic, seen from behind. The camera moves in past a curtain as they prepare to pray, with a bookshelf beside them.

Two men pray side by side on prayer mats in a hospital multi-faith prayer room, moving from standing through bowing and prostration, seen from behind. A small bookshelf stands in the corner and a dark curtain frames the left of the shot.
Two men kneel and pray side by side on prayer mats in a small multi-faith prayer room with a bookshelf in the corner, moving between kneeling and prostration. Both are filmed from behind.

Two men kneel in prayer on prayer mats in the hospital's multi-faith prayer room, with a small bookshelf against the back wall. The camera moves sideways past the doorway as one of the men rises from prostration.

Camera moves through a curtained doorway into a hospital prayer room where two men kneel in prostration on prayer mats facing the wall, with a small bookshelf in the corner. A quiet multi-faith room at The Harley Street Clinic.
A doorman in a dark suit opens the wooden double front doors of The Harley Street Clinic and smiles in welcome. The glass inner entrance doors of the lobby are visible behind him.

A receptionist in a dark uniform and neck scarf sits at the front desk of The Harley Street Clinic, smiles at the camera and gestures with an open hand as if directing a visitor. A second staff member works at a computer at the desk behind her.
